concerns.text: Task T001 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it must run before any downstream task that installs dependencies or writes seed logs. Running it in parallel with T002 or other tasks would cause race conditions, violating the parallel‑safety guarantee.

Task T002 is also marked `[P]` yet it depends on the environment set up by T001 (requirements.txt, seed initialization). Parallel execution with T001 or other tasks could fail due to missing packages or unsynchronized logs.
Task T003 carries the `[P]` tag but consumes the raw data produced by T002 and the seed state from T001. It cannot be safely executed concurrently with its producers, so the tag is inaccurate.
Task T009 is marked `[P]` but validates schemas against processed data that are only generated after T003 (and later tasks). Running it in parallel with those producers would cause false failures.

Task T010 is tagged `[P]` yet it relies on the complete pipeline output (T008) and the test suite (T009). Parallel execution with any of its prerequisites would break the runtime‑metrics enforcement logic.
